privacyCollectP1Prefix: When you sign in with Facebook, we receive your
privacyCollectP1Suffix: from your Facebook account. We use this information solely to create and display your in-game profile.
privacyCollectP2: If you register with a username and password, we store your username and a securely hashed version of your password. We never store your password in plain text.
privacyUseIntro: Your information is used exclusively to:
privacyUseLi1: Create and manage your game account
privacyUseLi2: Display your profile to other players
privacyUseLi3: Enable in-game features such as trading, leaderboards, and chat
privacyUseLi4: If you enable the Autopilot feature, send your game state (portfolio, market data, cooldowns) to the third-party AI provider YOU configure, under YOUR own API key and at YOUR own cost. Your API key is stored only in your browser and never reaches our servers.
privacySharingP1Suffix: sell, rent, or share your personal information with third parties. Your data stays within the n38worth platform.
privacyStorageP1: Your data is stored securely in encrypted databases. We use industry-standard security measures including HTTPS encryption, hashed passwords, and secure session management via JSON Web Tokens (JWT).
privacyDeletionP1: In-game accounts may be removed automatically based on game mechanics (player inactivity). You may also request full deletion of your data by contacting us.
privacyCookiesP1: We use essential cookies for authentication and session management. These are strictly necessary for the game to function and cannot be opted out of.
privacyChangesP1: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date.
privacyContactP1: If you have questions about this privacy policy or wish to request data deletion, please reach out through the in-game chat or contact us via our GitHub repository.
termsAcceptP1: By accessing or using n38worth, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, do not use the platform.
termsDescP1: n38worth is a city building game — acquire, renovate and trade buildings to crown your skyline. All in-game capital and values are virtual and have no real-world monetary value.
termsAccountP1: You may create an account using a username and password or by signing in with Facebook. You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account credentials. Each person may only operate one account.
termsMechanicsP1: The game includes mechanics such as player value changes and automatic account deletion for inactive players. These mechanics are part of the game design and may change at any time.
termsConductLi1: Use unauthorized automated tools, bots, or scripts to interact with the game (the built-in Autopilot feature is authorized automation, subject to its configured limits)
termsConductLi3: Harass, abuse, or threaten other players
termsConductLi4: Create multiple accounts to gain unfair advantages
termsTerminationP1: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate your account at any time for violations of these terms or for any other reason at our discretion.
termsDisclaimerP1: n38worth is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We are not liable for any loss of in-game progress, data, or virtual items.
termsChangesP1: We may update these terms at any time. Continued use of the platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms.
